# Draft:Kacey Ray Hauer-King

----
Kacey Ray Hauer-King Born On 05/01/2000 Is A Singer/ Songwriter And Actress From The United Kingdom She Is Well Known For Her Songs Bad Habit, This Hell And Bootylicious Ft Zara Larsson , Leigh-Anne And Saweetie. She Is Married To British Actor Jonah Hauer-King.
